text: dsh-icon-switch 是面向 DSH Web 设置页的图标管理插件，通过设置面板和本机图标引擎管理应用外观。用户可以浏览已有图标集、上传 PNG、JPEG、GIF 或 BMP 图片生成新图标集，并选择图标集应用或恢复原图标；还可设置圆角并切换侧栏品牌行显示。图标应用由随插件提供的 PowerShell 引擎处理，适合希望在 DSH 内更换应用与托盘图标的用户。运行需要 Windows PowerShell 及 DSH 图标资源目录的本地读写能力。

dsh-icon-switch adds icon controls to DSH Web Settings. Preview icon sets, upload PNG, JPEG, GIF, or BMP images to create a set, and apply or restore icons with PowerShell. Configure rounded corners or hide the sidebar brand row. Requires Windows PowerShell and local DSH icon files.
想在 DSH 设置里预览并换一套应用图标。
我想上传自己的图片，生成 DSH 应用和托盘图标。
How can I change or restore my DSH app icons from its settings page?
dsh-icon-switch 的功能「图标集预览与切换」：设置页展示已有图标集及预览图，选择图标集后可立即应用，也能恢复原始图标。
dsh-icon-switch 的功能「上传图片生成图标集」：在设置页选择 PNG、JPEG、GIF 或 BMP 图片并填写名称，插件调用 PowerShell 引擎生成图标集，支持配置圆角。
dsh-icon-switch 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 28 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-icon-switch README · dsh-icon-switch：In-app icon switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Change the app / tray / taskbar icon right from the Settings page, upload any image to generate a full icon set, round the corners, and optionally hide the sidebar brand row.

dsh-icon-switch README · Features：- **Icon gallery** — preview every installed icon set inside the DSH Settings page.
- **Upload → icon set** — upload a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP and the bundled PowerShell engine generates the full set (`app-icon.png/.ico` + tray sizes).
- **Rounded corners** — optional 26% corner radius; the square original is kept as `source.png` so toggling it off restores sharp corners.
- **Tray & taskbar** — writes `tray.ico`/`icon.png` for the app, updates Windows shortcuts, and sets the taskbar icon (Electron `setIcon` first, a resident PowerShell watcher as fallback).
- **Hide sidebar brand row** — optional pure-CSS toggle, instant.

dsh-icon-switch README · Install：```
dsh plugin add dsh-icon-switch
```

or from source:

```
dsh plugin add github:yturjzw/dsh-icon-switch
```

After installing, **fully quit and restart DSH** so the plugin loads and the tray icon is picked up.

dsh-icon-switch README · How it works：`lib/index.js` registers a settings section plus loopback-only HTTP routes under
`/api/dsh-icon-switch/`. The bundled `tool/dsh-icon-switch.ps1` engine reads and
writes icon sets under `tool/icons` (override the directory with the `toolDir`
setting if you want them to persist across plugin reinstalls).

dsh-icon-switch README · Layout：```
lib/index.js          host side: Config schema, routes, engine spawn
client/client.js      browser settings section (gallery, upload, form)
tool/                 bundled PowerShell engines + starter icon sets
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch

dsh-icon-switch README · Icon files：- `tray.ico` → `process.resourcesPath\tray.ico` (tray icon, read once at startup).
- `icon.png` → `process.resourcesPath\icon.png` (About panel; the window/taskbar icon is set via `setIcon`/WM_SETICON at runtime).
- ICO frames are built as 32 bpp DIB with an alpha-derived AND mask — PNG frames are rejected by some shell extraction paths and show up as a blank icon.
